All instructions to the AI agents across `SKILL.md`, `references/workflow.md`, `references/default-personas.md`, and `references/paper-notes-template.md` are focused on guiding task execution, maintaining academic integrity (e.g., strict citation rules, anti-fabrication instructions), and adopting specific personas. The prompt instructions are designed to enhance the agent's performance and integrity, not to subvert it.
